verdict.rationale: Sierra's own docs say hand-off rules are a configurable part of agent behavior that teams can experiment with. Journeys, guardrails and logic-as-code give a configuration surface, and Agent Checks and Simulations offer some way to verify the agent behaves as configured. The evidence never shows which handoff triggers are supported or that handoffs are reliably obeyed in practice. Missing for 10: documented triggers by topic, sentiment, customer tier and explicit request; documentation of the human handoff/escalation mechanism; independent or hands-on evidence of reliable compliance.
